title: TapTools: Enable Free Access to TapTax for All

ms.promise:
・Transform the existing paid user flow into an open and free flow by removing the paywall, allowing unrestricted access for all users.
・Updated user flow diagrams, implementation of code changes, deployment logs.
ms.criteria:
・The new user flow must be accessible without any payment barriers.
・Ensure a seamless transition with no disruptions to user access during the transition.
・Conduct user acceptance testing to verify that the flow works as intended without requiring payment.
ms.report:
Here is a Google Drive link of evidence of milestone completion: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WpotidU9ds0OMuinV5gOgn2nV-pFEzE5?usp=sharing
Evidence #2: We have removed the paywall and TapTax is now officially free for everyone. Here is the link to access: https://www.taptools.io/taptax
For the architecture documents and change logs, I posted in Evidence #1 in the Google Drive the changes from the paid version to the free version.
TapTax is FREE for all - please test for yourself.

ms.promise: Implement a support ticket system to handle inquiries and issues reported by users.
ms.criteria:
・The system must be able to handle multiple tickets simultaneously with a systematic tracking and resolution process.
・Response time should not exceed 24 hours for any ticket.
・System testing to ensure functionality and performance metrics are met.

ms.promise:
・Enable the integration of TapTax CSV exports with TurboTax and TaxAct.
・Updated documentation, user guide on how to perform integrations.
ms.criteria:
・Integrations must be robust, secure, and maintain the integrity of the data during transfers.
・Ensure all exported data aligns correctly with the formats required by other tax softwares.
・Conduct integration testing with each of the supported platforms.
ms.report:
・Documentation and user guide on how to perform integrations
・Tutorial video on how to upload to TurboTax
・Screenshots showing example TapTax CSV's for TurboTax and TaxAct
・Screenshot of TaxAct requirements (have to manually add the info from the TapTax CSV)

Here is a link to these points above: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1wYeJQNkHiCLQkqYgjaLfQYIN-rCGygbn?usp=sharing

ms.promise:
・Create and deploy an homepage banner advertisement campaign on our platform promoting the new free TapTax export feature.
・Conduct an awareness campaign on X to inform over 43,000 of our followers about utilizing TapTax, subsidized by Project Catalyst.
・Advertisement content, campaign plan, performance report for both campaigns.
ms.criteria:
・The banner advertisement campaign must be launched following the successful implementation of the open and free user flow and all necessary integrations.
・Successfully create and distribute a variety of engaging content, including posts, graphics, and videos highlighting the benefits of using TapTax on the X platform.
・Analyze engagement metrics and TapTax adoption rates post-campaign.
・Ensure that all backend systems and user interfaces are updated to support the new feature promoted by the advertisement to handle potential increases in user traffic.
ms.report:
Please access the full documentation for Milestone 4 here: Google Drive Link
This submission demonstrates our efforts to build awareness of TapTax and provides a foundation for ongoing engagement leading up to the 2025 tax season.
